lines.translation: In love and attachment to Maya, he has no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai guramat naam pragaasee he ||14||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh sees nothing; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is gloriously revealed. ||14||
The manmukhs are asleep in egotism and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa ghar na samaalahi a(n)t vigoote ||
lines.translation: They do not watch over their own homes, and are ruined in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa karahi bahu chi(n)taa jaalai dukhe dukh nivaasee he ||15||
lines.translation: They slander others, and burn in great anxiety; they dwell in pain and suffering. ||15||
The Creator Himself has created the creation.
He blesses the Gurmukh with understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate man niramal naame naam nivaasee he ||16||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam - their minds become immaculate; they dwell in the Naam, and only the Naam. ||16||5||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:
I serve the One Lord, who is eternal, stable and True.
Attached to duality, the whole world is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee sadaa sach saalaahee saache hee saach pateejai he ||1||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I praise the True Lord forever, pleased with the Truest of the True. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaataa ||
lines.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are so many, Lord; I do not know even one.
The Life of the world, the Great Giver, attaches us to himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase de vadiaaee guramat ihu man bheejai he ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and bestows glorious greatness. Following the Guru's Teachings, this mind is delighted. ||2||
The Word of the Shabad has subdued the waves of Maya.
Egotism has been conquered, and this mind has become immaculate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa rasanaa raam raveejai he ||3||
lines.translation: I intuitively sing His Glorious Praises, imbued with the Lord's Love. My tongue chants and savors the Lord's Name. ||3||
Crying out, "Mine, mine!" he spends his life.
The self-willed manmukh does not understand; he wanders around in ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal ghaRee muhat nihaale anadin aarajaa chheejai he ||4||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death watches over him every moment, every instant; night and day, his life is wasting away. ||4||
He practices greed within, and does not understand.
He does not see the Messenger of Death hovering over his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aithai kamaanaa s agai aaiaa a(n)takaal kiaa keejai he ||5||
lines.translation: Whatever one does in this world, will come to face him in the hereafter; what can he do at that very last moment? ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sach laage tin saachee soi ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the Truth are true.
The self-willed manmukhs, attached to duality, weep and wail.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam hai aape aape gun mahi bheejai he ||6||
lines.translation: He is the Lord and Master of both worlds; He Himself delights in virtue. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa jan sohai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His humble servant is exalted forever.
This mind is enticed by the Naam, the source of nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa moh mail pata(n)g na laagai guramatee har naam bheejai he ||7||
lines.translation: It is not stained at all by the dirt of attachment to Maya; through the Guru's Teachings, it is pleased and saturated with the Lord's Name. ||7||
The One Lord is contained within all.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar sadaa sukh paaiaa naai saachai a(n)mrit peejai he ||8||
lines.translation: One who subdues his ego, finds lasting peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name. ||8||
God is the Destroyer of sin and pain.
The Gurmukh serves Him, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap varatai guramukh tan man bheejai he ||9||
lines.translation: He Himself is pervading everything. The Gurmukh's body and mind are saturated and pleased. ||9||
The world is burning in the fire of Maya.
The Gurmukh extinguishes this fire, by contemplating the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh paaiaa guramatee naam leejai he ||10||
lines.translation: Deep within are peace and tranquility, and lasting peace is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dr i(n)draasan baithe jam kaa bhau paavahi ||
lines.translation: Even Indra, seated upon his throne, is caught in the fear of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam na chhodai bahu karam kamaavahi ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death will not spare them, even though they try all sorts of things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhetai taa mukat paaeeai har har rasanaa peejai he ||11||
lines.translation: When one meets with the True Guru, one is liberated, drinking in and savoring the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||11||
There is no devotion within the self-willed manmukh.
Through devotional worship, the Gurmukh obtains peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: pavitr paavan sadaa hai baanee guramat a(n)tar bheejai he ||12||
lines.translation: Forever pure and sanctified is the Word of the Guru's Bani; following the Guru's Teachings, one's inner being is drenched in it. ||12||
I have considered Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
They are bound by the three qualities - the three gunas; they are far away from liberation.
